query:
SELECT e.id, e.sessionId, e.evaluatorStudentId, e.evaluatedStudentId, e.pontualidade, e.pesquisaMetas, e.dominio, e.participacao
FROM evaluations e
WHERE e.sessionId = 720002 AND e.evaluatedStudentId = 300027
LIMIT 5;
